title: compensation_budget causal_depth_v1
description: 独立工程接口；教师提案经主审后执行。字段缺省在compiler补齐，显式字段均生效。

mode.description: 启用有界分层最佳优先补偿；旧模式及缺省策略不变

max_new_states_per_candidate.description: 每轮每primary新补偿状态上限；预筛single另计入全局预算，缓存不重复扣费

max_new_states_per_layer.description: 每primary每深度新增评价上限；未用额度不阻止下一深度

beam_width.description: 每层按真实loss、Q15修复、库大小、状态ID保留的frontier宽度

max_depth.description: single之后最多动作边数；replace原子边同时一加一删

action_order.description: 跨层持续轮转动作族；族为空时跳过，避免低index新增吞掉删除机会

max_nonmonotone_steps.description: 每路径允许loss不严格下降的边数；不放宽最终gate

max_loss_increase.description: 单边真实protected loss事件数最多增加量

max_extended_primaries.description: 每轮可使用大于3add上限的实测丢类primary数量，按预筛排名分配；0关闭

extended_min_lost_classes.description: 允许扩展add额度的single实测丢gold类数门槛；不锁seed成员

initial_states_per_candidate.description: 第一阶段每primary新状态配额；第二阶段将剩余预算优先给实测loss下降路径，且不超过每primary总上限

allOf.description: initial_states_per_candidate <= max_new_states_per_candidate; compiler enforces cross-field inequality

maximum_trials.scope: all distinct states of this member across rounds, including prescreen and diagnostic counterfactuals

maximum_additions.effect: cap6 only within configured measured-loss-class primary subset

maximum_deletions.effect: net deletions from current anchor, including atomic replace

maximum_pool_candidates.effect: unchanged generated cosine-truncated eligible TRAIN primary pool
